ABC Analysis is an approach for classifying items based on their classification value. The value is the total value of an item calculated over a specified time period. This approach is based off the Pareto Principal i.e. the 80/20 rule which states for many events, 80% of the effects come from 20% of the causes. The ABC Indicator denotes which items are classified as: A - Signficant Material, B - Medium Significance Material, C - Low Significance Material, D - Least Significance, E- Zero Significance or O - Obsolete.
exampleValues: A, B, C, D, E, or O

VAR __critical = 0.0025
VAR __veryImp = 0.001
VAR Max_Year=MAX('WFA Yearly Targets'[Year])
VAR __WFATarget =
    CALCULATE (
        VALUES ( 'WFA Yearly Targets'[Target 100 Percent] ),  FILTER (
            'WFA Yearly Targets Reporting Unit',
            'WFA Yearly Targets Reporting Unit'[Prod Hier: Reporting Unit Code]
                = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'Material'[Prod Hier: Reporting Unit Code] )
        ),
        'WFA Yearly Targets'[WFA Target Prod Hier: Reporting Unit] <> "NA Corporate Total"
        ,'WFA Yearly Targets'[Year] = Max_Year
    )

VAR __vb =
    SELECTEDVALUE ( 'View By'[View By], "Units" )
VAR __Month = 1
VAR __Month_1 =
    CALCULATE (
        MAX ( 'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Cal._year_/_month] ),
        'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Month_Offset] = __Month
    )
VAR __Month_2 =
    CALCULATE (
        MAX ( 'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Cal._year_/_month] ),
        'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Month_Offset] = __Month + 1
    )
VAR __Month_3 =
    CALCULATE (
        MAX ( 'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Cal._year_/_month] ),
        'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Month_Offset] = __Month + 2
    )
VAR __ALLErr =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 1 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error],
        ALLSELECTED ( 'Demand Forecasts 2.0' ),
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[SOH_Flag] = "Unversioned",
        REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Time'[Month End Date] ),
        AND (
            'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] >= __Month_3,
            'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] <= __Month_1
        )
    )
VAR __Err1 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 1 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[SOH_Flag] = "Unversioned",
        REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Time'[Month End Date] ),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_1
    )
VAR __Err2 =
    CALCULATE (

    )
VAR __Attain2 =

    )
VAR __Attain3 =

        'View By'[View By Consensus Attainement 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Time'[Month End Date] ),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_3
    )
VAR __WFA1 =

        'View By'[View By Err Level 1 Consensus WFA],
        REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Time'[Month End Date] ),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_1,

    )

        'View By'[View By Err Level 1 Consensus WFA],
        REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Time'[Month End Date] ),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_2
    )
VAR __WFA3 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 1 Consensus WFA],
        REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Time'[Month End Date] ),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_3
    )
VAR __Err =
    IF (
        AND (
            OR ( NOT ISBLANK ( __SOH1 ), NOT ISBLANK ( __CD1 ) ),
            AND (
                OR ( NOT ISBLANK ( __SOH2 ), NOT ISBLANK ( __CD2 ) ),
                OR ( NOT ISBLANK ( __SOH3 ), NOT ISBLANK ( __CD3 ) )
            )
        ),
        1
    )
VAR __WFA =
    IF (
        NOT ISBLANK ( __Err ),
        IF (
            AND ( __WFA1 < __WFATarget, AND ( __WFA2 < __WFATarget, __WFA3 < __WFATarget ) ),
            0.34
        )
    )
VAR __CurAttain =
    IF (
        NOT ISBLANK ( __Err ),
        IF (
            AND (
                OR ( ISBLANK ( __Attain1 ), __Attain1 > 1.15 ),
                AND (
                    OR ( ISBLANK ( __Attain2 ), __Attain2 > 1.15 ),
                    OR ( ISBLANK ( __Attain3 ), __Attain3 > 1.15 )
                )
            ),

                AND (
                    AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __Attain1 ), __Attain1 < 0.85 ),
                    AND (
                        AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __Attain2 ), __Attain2 < 0.85 ),
                        AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __Attain3 ), __Attain3 < 0.85 )
                    )

            AND (
                AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __WFA ), __WFA < __WFATarget ),

            )
        ),
        "Critical",
        --"Critical"
        IF (
            AND (
                __percentile > __veryImp,
                AND (
                    AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __WFA ), __WFA < __WFATarget ),
                    OR ( __CurAttain < 0.85, __CurAttain > 1.15 )
                )
            ),
            "Very Important",
            --"Very Important"
            IF (
                AND (
                    __percentile > __critical,
                    AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __WFA ), __WFA < __WFATarget )
                ),
                "Important",
                --"Important"
                IF (
                    AND (
                        AND (
                            __percentilePM > __critical,
                            AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __WFA1 ), __WFA1 < __WFATarget )
                        ),
                        OR ( __Attain1 < 0.85, __Attain1 > 1.15 )
                    ),
                    "PM Exceptions",
                    --"PM Exceptions"
                    "Ignore" --"Ignore"
                )
            )
        )
    )
RETURN
    IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [View By Err Level 1 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error] ), __Calc )

field: Err Level 2 Dynamic Final Consensus Abs Error in USD YTD Trend
calculation:
VAR A =
    SELECTEDVALUE ( 'Time'[Month End Date] )
VAR B =
    CALCULATE ( VALUES ( 'Time'[Year] ), 'Time'[Month End Date] = A )
VAR C =
    DATE ( B, 1, 1 )
RETURN
    CALCULATE (
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Err Level 2 Dynamic Final Consensus Abs Error in USD],
        DATESBETWEEN ( 'Time'[Reporting Date], C, A )
    )

VAR __critical = 0.0025 
VAR __veryImp = 0.001
VAR Max_Year=MAX('WFA Yearly Targets'[Year])
VAR __WFATarget =
    CALCULATE (
        VALUES ( 'WFA Yearly Targets'[Target 100 Percent] ),  FILTER (
            'WFA Yearly Targets Reporting Unit',
            'WFA Yearly Targets Reporting Unit'[Prod Hier: Reporting Unit Code]
                = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'Material'[Prod Hier: Reporting Unit Code] )
        ),
        'WFA Yearly Targets'[WFA Target Prod Hier: Reporting Unit] <> "NA Corporate Total"
        ,'WFA Yearly Targets'[Year] = Max_Year
    )

VAR __vb =
    SELECTEDVALUE ( 'View By'[View By], "Units" )
VAR __Month = 1
VAR __Month_1 =
    CALCULATE (
        MAX ( 'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Cal._year_/_month] ),
        'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Month_Offset] = __Month
    )
VAR __Month_2 =
    CALCULATE (
        MAX ( 'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Cal._year_/_month] ),
        'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Month_Offset] = __Month + 1
    )
VAR __Month_3 =
    CALCULATE (
        MAX ( 'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Cal._year_/_month] ),
        'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Month_Offset] = __Month + 2
    )
VAR __ALLErr =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 2 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error],
        ALLSELECTED ( 'Demand Forecasts 2.0' ),
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[SOH_Flag] = "Unversioned",
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        AND (
            'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] >= __Month_3,
            'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] <= __Month_1
        )
    )
VAR __Err1 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 2 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[SOH_Flag] = "Unversioned",
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_1
    )
VAR __Err2 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 2 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[SOH_Flag] = "Unversioned",
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_2
    )
VAR __Err3 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 2 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[SOH_Flag] = "Unversioned",
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_3
    )
VAR __SOH1 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Sales Order History 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_1,
        'View By'[View By] = __vb
    )
VAR __SOH2 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Sales Order History 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_2
    )
VAR __SOH3 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Sales Order History 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_3
    )
VAR __CD1 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Consensus Demand 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_1,
        'View By'[View By] = __vb
    )
VAR __CD2 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Consensus Demand 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_2
    )
VAR __CD3 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Consensus Demand 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_3
    )
VAR __Attain1 =
    CALCULATE (
        [Consensus Attainement in UNT 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_1
    )
VAR __Attain2 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Consensus Attainement 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_2
    )
VAR __Attain3 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Consensus Attainement 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_3
    )
VAR __WFA1 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 2 Consensus WFA],
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_1,
        'View By'[View By] = __vb
    )
VAR __WFA2 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 2 Consensus WFA],
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_2
    )
VAR __WFA3 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 2 Consensus WFA],
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_3
    )


VAR __Err =
    IF (
        AND (
            OR ( NOT ISBLANK ( __SOH1 ), NOT ISBLANK ( __CD1 ) ),
            AND (
                OR ( NOT ISBLANK ( __SOH2 ), NOT ISBLANK ( __CD2 ) ),
                OR ( NOT ISBLANK ( __SOH3 ), NOT ISBLANK ( __CD3 ) )
            )
        ),
        1
    )
VAR __WFA =
    IF (
        NOT ISBLANK ( __Err ),
        IF ( AND ( __WFA1 < __WFATarget, AND ( __WFA2 < __WFATarget, __WFA3 < __WFATarget ) ), 0.34 )
    )
VAR __CurAttain =
IF (
    NOT ISBLANK ( __Err ),
    IF (
        AND (
            OR ( ISBLANK ( __Attain1 ), __Attain1 > 1.15 ),
            AND (
                OR ( ISBLANK ( __Attain2 ), __Attain2 > 1.15 ),
                OR ( ISBLANK ( __Attain3 ), __Attain3 > 1.15 )
            )
        ),
        1.16,
        IF (
            AND (
                AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __Attain1 ), __Attain1 < 0.85 ),
                AND (
                    AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __Attain2 ), __Attain2 < 0.85 ),
                    AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __Attain3 ), __Attain3 < 0.85 )
                )
            ),
            0.84,
            1
        )
    )
)
VAR __AllErrPM =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 2 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error],
        ALLSELECTED ( 'Demand Forecasts 2.0' ),
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[SOH_Flag] = "Unversioned",
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_1
    )
VAR __percentile = ( __Err1 + __Err2 + __Err3 ) / __ALLErr
VAR __percentilePM = __Err1 / __ALLErrPM
VAR __Calc =
    IF (
        AND (
            __percentile > __critical,
            AND (
                AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __WFA ), __WFA < __WFATarget ),
                OR ( __CurAttain < 0.85, __CurAttain > 1.15 )
            )
        ),
        "Critical",
        --"Critical"
        IF (
            AND (
                __percentile > __veryImp,
                AND (
                    AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __WFA ), __WFA < __WFATarget ),
                    OR ( __CurAttain < 0.85, __CurAttain > 1.15 )
                )
            ),
            "Very Important",
            --"Very Important"
            IF (
                AND ( __percentile > __critical, AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __WFA ), __WFA < __WFATarget ) ),
                "Important",
                --"Important"
                IF (
                    AND (
                        AND ( __percentilePM > __critical, AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __WFA1 ), __WFA1 < __WFATarget ) ),
                        OR ( __Attain1 < 0.85, __Attain1 > 1.15 )
                    ),
                    "PM Exceptions",
                    --"PM Exceptions"
                    "Ignore" --"Ignore"
                )
            )
        )
    )
RETURN
    IF (
    NOT ISBLANK ( [View By Err Level 2 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error] ),
     __Calc )

VAR __critical = 0.0025 
VAR __veryImp = 0.001
VAR Max_Year=MAX('WFA Yearly Targets'[Year])
VAR __WFATarget =
    CALCULATE (
        VALUES ( 'WFA Yearly Targets'[Target 100 Percent] ),  FILTER (
            'WFA Yearly Targets Reporting Unit',
            'WFA Yearly Targets Reporting Unit'[Prod Hier: Reporting Unit Code]
                = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'Material'[Prod Hier: Reporting Unit Code] )
        ),
        'WFA Yearly Targets'[WFA Target Prod Hier: Reporting Unit] <> "NA Corporate Total"
        ,'WFA Yearly Targets'[Year] = Max_Year
    )

VAR __vb =
    SELECTEDVALUE ( 'View By'[View By], "Units" )
VAR __Month = 1
VAR __Month_1 =
    CALCULATE (
        MAX ( 'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Cal._year_/_month] ),
        'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Month_Offset] = __Month
    )
VAR __Month_2 =
    CALCULATE (
        MAX ( 'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Cal._year_/_month] ),
        'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Month_Offset] = __Month + 1
    )
VAR __Month_3 =
    CALCULATE (
        MAX ( 'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Cal._year_/_month] ),
        'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Month_Offset] = __Month + 2
    )
VAR __ALLErr =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 3 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error],
        ALLSELECTED ( 'Demand Forecasts 2.0' ),
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[SOH_Flag] = "Unversioned",
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        AND (
            'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] >= __Month_3,
            'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] <= __Month_1
        )
    )
VAR __Err1 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 3 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[SOH_Flag] = "Unversioned",
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_1
    )
VAR __Err2 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 3 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[SOH_Flag] = "Unversioned",
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_2
    )
VAR __Err3 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 3 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[SOH_Flag] = "Unversioned",
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_3
    )
VAR __SOH1 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Sales Order History 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_1,
        'View By'[View By] = __vb
    )
VAR __SOH2 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Sales Order History 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_2
    )
VAR __SOH3 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Sales Order History 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_3
    )
VAR __CD1 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Consensus Demand 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_1,
        'View By'[View By] = __vb
    )
VAR __CD2 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Consensus Demand 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_2
    )
VAR __CD3 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Consensus Demand 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_3
    )
VAR __Attain1 =
    CALCULATE (
        [Consensus Attainement in UNT 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_1
    )
VAR __Attain2 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Consensus Attainement 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_2
    )
VAR __Attain3 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Consensus Attainement 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_3
    )
VAR __WFA1 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 3 Consensus WFA],
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_1,
        'View By'[View By] = __vb
    )
VAR __WFA2 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 3 Consensus WFA],
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_2
    )
VAR __WFA3 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 3 Consensus WFA],
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_3
    )


VAR __Err =
    IF (
        AND (
            OR ( NOT ISBLANK ( __SOH1 ), NOT ISBLANK ( __CD1 ) ),
            AND (
                OR ( NOT ISBLANK ( __SOH2 ), NOT ISBLANK ( __CD2 ) ),
                OR ( NOT ISBLANK ( __SOH3 ), NOT ISBLANK ( __CD3 ) )
            )
        ),
        1
    )
VAR __WFA =
    IF (
        NOT ISBLANK ( __Err ),
        IF ( AND ( __WFA1 < __WFATarget, AND ( __WFA2 < __WFATarget, __WFA3 < __WFATarget ) ), 0.34 )
    )
VAR __CurAttain =
IF (
    NOT ISBLANK ( __Err ),
    IF (
        AND (
            OR ( ISBLANK ( __Attain1 ), __Attain1 > 1.15 ),
            AND (
                OR ( ISBLANK ( __Attain2 ), __Attain2 > 1.15 ),
                OR ( ISBLANK ( __Attain3 ), __Attain3 > 1.15 )
            )
        ),
        1.16,
        IF (
            AND (
                AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __Attain1 ), __Attain1 < 0.85 ),
                AND (
                    AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __Attain2 ), __Attain2 < 0.85 ),
                    AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __Attain3 ), __Attain3 < 0.85 )
                )
            ),
            0.84,
            1
        )
    )
)
VAR __AllErrPM =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 3 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error],
        ALLSELECTED ( 'Demand Forecasts 2.0' ),
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[SOH_Flag] = "Unversioned",
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_1
    )
VAR __percentile = ( __Err1 + __Err2 + __Err3 ) / __ALLErr
VAR __percentilePM = __Err1 / __ALLErrPM
VAR __Calc =
    IF (
        AND (
            __percentile > __critical,
            AND (
                AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __WFA ), __WFA < __WFATarget ),
                OR ( __CurAttain < 0.85, __CurAttain > 1.15 )
            )
        ),
        "Critical",
        --"Critical"
        IF (
            AND (
                __percentile > __veryImp,
                AND (
                    AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __WFA ), __WFA < __WFATarget ),
                    OR ( __CurAttain < 0.85, __CurAttain > 1.15 )
                )
            ),
            "Very Important",
            --"Very Important"
            IF (
                AND ( __percentile > __critical, AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __WFA ), __WFA < __WFATarget ) ),
                "Important",
                --"Important"
                IF (
                    AND (
                        AND ( __percentilePM > __critical, AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __WFA1 ), __WFA1 < __WFATarget ) ),
                        OR ( __Attain1 < 0.85, __Attain1 > 1.15 )
                    ),
                    "PM Exceptions",
                    --"PM Exceptions"
                    "Ignore" --"Ignore"
                )
            )
        )
    )
RETURN
    IF (
    NOT ISBLANK ( [View By Err Level 3 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error] ),
     __Calc )

VAR __critical = 0.0025 
VAR __veryImp = 0.001
VAR Max_Year=MAX('WFA Yearly Targets'[Year])
VAR __WFATarget =
    CALCULATE (
        VALUES ( 'WFA Yearly Targets'[Target 100 Percent] ),  FILTER (
            'WFA Yearly Targets Reporting Unit',
            'WFA Yearly Targets Reporting Unit'[Prod Hier: Reporting Unit Code]
                = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'Material'[Prod Hier: Reporting Unit Code] )
        ),
        'WFA Yearly Targets'[WFA Target Prod Hier: Reporting Unit] <> "NA Corporate Total"
        ,'WFA Yearly Targets'[Year] = Max_Year
    )

VAR __vb =
    SELECTEDVALUE ( 'View By'[View By], "Units" )
VAR __Month = 1
VAR __Month_1 =
    CALCULATE (
        MAX ( 'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Cal._year_/_month] ),
        'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Month_Offset] = __Month
    )
VAR __Month_2 =
    CALCULATE (
        MAX ( 'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Cal._year_/_month] ),
        'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Month_Offset] = __Month + 1
    )
VAR __Month_3 =
    CALCULATE (
        MAX ( 'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Cal._year_/_month] ),
        'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Month_Offset] = __Month + 2
    )
VAR __ALLErr =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 5 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error],
        ALLSELECTED ( 'Demand Forecasts 2.0' ),
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[SOH_Flag] = "Unversioned",
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        AND (
            'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] >= __Month_3,
            'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] <= __Month_1
        )
    )
VAR __Err1 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 5 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[SOH_Flag] = "Unversioned",
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_1
    )
VAR __Err2 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 5 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[SOH_Flag] = "Unversioned",
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_2
    )
VAR __Err3 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 5 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[SOH_Flag] = "Unversioned",
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_3
    )
VAR __SOH1 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Sales Order History 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_1,
        'View By'[View By] = __vb
    )
VAR __SOH2 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Sales Order History 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_2
    )
VAR __SOH3 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Sales Order History 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_3
    )
VAR __CD1 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Consensus Demand 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_1,
        'View By'[View By] = __vb
    )
VAR __CD2 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Consensus Demand 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_2
    )
VAR __CD3 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Consensus Demand 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_3
    )
VAR __Attain1 =
    CALCULATE (
        [Consensus Attainement in UNT 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_1
    )
VAR __Attain2 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Consensus Attainement 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),

    )

        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_1,

    )

        'View By'[View By Err Level 5 Consensus WFA],
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_2
    )

        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),

VAR __Err =
    IF (
        AND (
            OR ( NOT ISBLANK ( __SOH1 ), NOT ISBLANK ( __CD1 ) ),
            AND (
                OR ( NOT ISBLANK ( __SOH2 ), NOT ISBLANK ( __CD2 ) ),
                OR ( NOT ISBLANK ( __SOH3 ), NOT ISBLANK ( __CD3 ) )
            )
        ),
        1
    )
VAR __WFA =
    IF (
        NOT ISBLANK ( __Err ),
        IF ( AND ( __WFA1 < __WFATarget, AND ( __WFA2 < __WFATarget, __WFA3 < __WFATarget ) ), 0.34 )
    )
VAR __CurAttain =
    IF (
    NOT ISBLANK ( __Err ),
    IF (
        AND (
            OR ( ISBLANK ( __Attain1 ), __Attain1 > 1.15 ),
            AND (
                OR ( ISBLANK ( __Attain2 ), __Attain2 > 1.15 ),
                OR ( ISBLANK ( __Attain3 ), __Attain3 > 1.15 )
            )
        ),
        1.16,
        IF (
            AND (
                AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __Attain1 ), __Attain1 < 0.85 ),
                AND (
                    AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __Attain2 ), __Attain2 < 0.85 ),
                    AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __Attain3 ), __Attain3 < 0.85 )
                )
            ),
            0.84,
            1
        )
    )

VAR __AllErrPM =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 5 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error],
        ALLSELECTED ( 'Demand Forecasts 2.0' ),
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[SOH_Flag] = "Unversioned",
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_1
    )
VAR __percentile = ( __Err1 + __Err2 + __Err3 ) / __ALLErr
VAR __percentilePM = __Err1 / __ALLErrPM
VAR __Calc =
    IF (
        AND (
            __percentile > __critical,
            AND (
                AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __WFA ), __WFA < __WFATarget ),
                OR ( __CurAttain < 0.85, __CurAttain > 1.15 )
            )
        ),
        "Critical",
        --"Critical"

            AND (
                __percentile > __veryImp,
                AND (
                    AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __WFA ), __WFA < __WFATarget ),
                    OR ( __CurAttain < 0.85, __CurAttain > 1.15 )
                )
            ),
            "Very Important",
            --"Very Important"
            IF (
                AND ( __percentile > __critical, AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __WFA ), __WFA < __WFATarget ) ),
                "Important",
                --"Important"
                IF (
                    AND (
                        AND ( __percentilePM > __critical, AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __WFA1 ), __WFA1 < __WFATarget ) ),
                        OR ( __Attain1 < 0.85, __Attain1 > 1.15 )
                    ),
                    "PM Exceptions",
                    --"PM Exceptions"
                    "Ignore" --"Ignore"
                )
            )
        )
    )
RETURN
    IF (
    NOT ISBLANK ( [View By Err Level 5 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error] ),
     __Calc )

field: Err Level 7 Dynamic Final Consensus Abs Error in USD YTD Trend
calculation:
VAR A =
    SELECTEDVALUE ( 'Time'[Month End Date] )
VAR B =
    CALCULATE ( VALUES ( 'Time'[Year] ), 'Time'[Month End Date] = A )
VAR C =
    DATE ( B, 1, 1 )
RETURN
    CALCULATE (
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Err Level 7 Dynamic Final Consensus Abs Error in USD],
        DATESBETWEEN ( 'Time'[Reporting Date], C, A )
    )

VAR __critical = 0.016 
VAR __veryImp = 0.011
VAR Max_Year=MAX('WFA Yearly Targets'[Year])
VAR __WFATarget =
    CALCULATE (
        VALUES ( 'WFA Yearly Targets'[Target 100 Percent] ),  FILTER (
            'WFA Yearly Targets Reporting Unit',
            'WFA Yearly Targets Reporting Unit'[Prod Hier: Reporting Unit Code]
                = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'Material'[Prod Hier: Reporting Unit Code] )
        ),
        'WFA Yearly Targets'[WFA Target Prod Hier: Reporting Unit] <> "NA Corporate Total"
        ,'WFA Yearly Targets'[Year] = Max_Year
    )
VAR __vb =
    SELECTEDVALUE ( 'View By'[View By], "Units" )
VAR __Month = 1
VAR __Month_1 =
    CALCULATE (
        MAX ( 'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Cal._year_/_month] ),
        'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Month_Offset] = __Month
    )
VAR __Month_2 =
    CALCULATE (
        MAX ( 'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Cal._year_/_month] ),
        'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Month_Offset] = __Month + 1
    )
VAR __Month_3 =
    CALCULATE (
        MAX ( 'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Cal._year_/_month] ),
        'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Month_Offset] = __Month + 2
    )
VAR __ALLErr =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 7 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error],
        ALLSELECTED ( 'Demand Forecasts 2.0' ),
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[SOH_Flag] = "Unversioned",
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        AND (
            'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] >= __Month_3,
            'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] <= __Month_1
        )
    )
VAR __Err1 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 7 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[SOH_Flag] = "Unversioned",
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_1
    )
VAR __Err2 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 7 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[SOH_Flag] = "Unversioned",
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_2
    )
VAR __Err3 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 7 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[SOH_Flag] = "Unversioned",
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_3
    )
VAR __SOH1 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Sales Order History 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_1,
        'View By'[View By] = __vb
    )
VAR __SOH2 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Sales Order History 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_2
    )
VAR __SOH3 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Sales Order History 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_3
    )
VAR __CD1 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Consensus Demand 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_1,
        'View By'[View By] = __vb
    )
VAR __CD2 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Consensus Demand 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_2
    )
VAR __CD3 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Consensus Demand 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_3
    )
VAR __Attain1 =
    CALCULATE (
        [Consensus Attainement in UNT 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_1
    )
VAR __Attain2 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Consensus Attainement 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_2
    )
VAR __Attain3 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Consensus Attainement 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_3
    )
VAR __WFA1 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 7 Consensus WFA],
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_1,
        'View By'[View By] = __vb
    )
VAR __WFA2 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 7 Consensus WFA],
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_2
    )
VAR __WFA3 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 7 Consensus WFA],
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_3
    )


VAR __Err =
    IF (
        AND (
            OR ( NOT ISBLANK ( __SOH1 ), NOT ISBLANK ( __CD1 ) ),
            AND (
                OR ( NOT ISBLANK ( __SOH2 ), NOT ISBLANK ( __CD2 ) ),
                OR ( NOT ISBLANK ( __SOH3 ), NOT ISBLANK ( __CD3 ) )
            )
        ),
        1
    )
VAR __WFA =
    IF (
        NOT ISBLANK ( __Err ),
        IF ( AND ( __WFA1 < __WFATarget, AND ( __WFA2 < __WFATarget, __WFA3 < __WFATarget ) ), 0.34 )
    )
VAR __CurAttain =
    IF (
    NOT ISBLANK ( __Err ),
    IF (
        AND (
            OR ( ISBLANK ( __Attain1 ), __Attain1 > 1.15 ),
            AND (
                OR ( ISBLANK ( __Attain2 ), __Attain2 > 1.15 ),
                OR ( ISBLANK ( __Attain3 ), __Attain3 > 1.15 )
            )
        ),
        1.16,
        IF (
            AND (
                AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __Attain1 ), __Attain1 < 0.85 ),
                AND (
                    AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __Attain2 ), __Attain2 < 0.85 ),
                    AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __Attain3 ), __Attain3 < 0.85 )
                )
            ),
            0.84,
            1
        )
    )
)
VAR __AllErrPM =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 7 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error],
        ALLSELECTED ( 'Demand Forecasts 2.0' ),
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[SOH_Flag] = "Unversioned",
        REMOVEFILTERS('Time'[Month End Date]),
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_1
    )
VAR __percentile = ( __Err1 + __Err2 + __Err3 ) / __ALLErr
VAR __percentilePM = __Err1 / __ALLErrPM
VAR __Calc =
    IF (
        AND (
            __percentile > __critical,
            AND (
                AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __WFA ), __WFA < __WFATarget ),
                OR ( __CurAttain < 0.85, __CurAttain > 1.15 )
            )
        ),
        "Critical",
        --"Critical"
        IF (
            AND (
                __percentile > __veryImp,
                AND (
                    AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __WFA ), __WFA < __WFATarget ),
                    OR ( __CurAttain < 0.85, __CurAttain > 1.15 )
                )
            ),
            "Very Important",
            --"Very Important"
            IF (
                AND ( __percentile > __critical, AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __WFA ), __WFA < __WFATarget ) ),
                "Important",
                --"Important"
                IF (
                    AND (
                        AND ( __percentilePM > __critical, AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __WFA1 ), __WFA1 < __WFATarget ) ),
                        OR ( __Attain1 < 0.85, __Attain1 > 1.15 )
                    ),
                    "PM Exceptions",
                    --"PM Exceptions"
                    "Ignore" --"Ignore"
                )
            )
        )
    )
RETURN
    IF (
    NOT ISBLANK ( [View By Err Level 7 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error] ),
     __Calc )

VAR __critical = 0.016 
VAR __veryImp = 0.011
VAR Max_Year=MAX('WFA Yearly Targets'[Year])
VAR __WFATarget =
    CALCULATE (
        VALUES ( 'WFA Yearly Targets'[Target 100 Percent] ),  FILTER (
            'WFA Yearly Targets Reporting Unit',
            'WFA Yearly Targets Reporting Unit'[Prod Hier: Reporting Unit Code]
                = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'Material'[Prod Hier: Reporting Unit Code] )
        ),
        'WFA Yearly Targets'[WFA Target Prod Hier: Reporting Unit] <> "NA Corporate Total"
        ,'WFA Yearly Targets'[Year] = Max_Year
    )

VAR __vb =
    SELECTEDVALUE ( 'View By'[View By], "Units" )
VAR __Month = 1
VAR __Month_1 =
    CALCULATE (
        MAX ( 'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Cal._year_/_month] ),
        'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Month_Offset] = __Month
    )
VAR __Month_2 =
    CALCULATE (
        MAX ( 'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Cal._year_/_month] ),
        'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Month_Offset] = __Month + 1
    )
VAR __Month_3 =
    CALCULATE (
        MAX ( 'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Cal._year_/_month] ),
        'Forecast Diagnostics Focus Filter Months'[Month_Offset] = __Month + 2
    )
VAR __ALLErr =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 8 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error],
        ALLSELECTED ( 'Demand Forecasts 2.0' ),
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[SOH_Flag] = "Unversioned",
        AND (
            'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] >= __Month_3,
            'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] <= __Month_1
        )
    )
VAR __Err1 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 8 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[SOH_Flag] = "Unversioned",
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_1
    )
VAR __Err2 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 8 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[SOH_Flag] = "Unversioned",
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_2
    )
VAR __Err3 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 8 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[SOH_Flag] = "Unversioned",
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_3
    )
VAR __SOH1 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Sales Order History 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_1,
        'View By'[View By] = __vb
    )
VAR __SOH2 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Sales Order History 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_2
    )
VAR __SOH3 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Sales Order History 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_3
    )
VAR __CD1 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Consensus Demand 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_1,
        'View By'[View By] = __vb
    )
VAR __CD2 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Consensus Demand 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_2
    )
VAR __CD3 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Consensus Demand 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_3
    )
VAR __Attain1 =
    CALCULATE (
        [Consensus Attainement in UNT 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_1
    )
VAR __Attain2 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Consensus Attainement 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_2
    )
VAR __Attain3 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Consensus Attainement 2.0],
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_3
    )
VAR __WFA1 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 8 Consensus WFA],
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_1,
        'View By'[View By] = __vb
    )
VAR __WFA2 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 8 Consensus WFA],
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_2
    )
VAR __WFA3 =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 8 Consensus WFA],
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_3
    )


VAR __Err =
    IF (
        AND (
            OR ( NOT ISBLANK ( __SOH1 ), NOT ISBLANK ( __CD1 ) ),
            AND (
                OR ( NOT ISBLANK ( __SOH2 ), NOT ISBLANK ( __CD2 ) ),
                OR ( NOT ISBLANK ( __SOH3 ), NOT ISBLANK ( __CD3 ) )
            )
        ),
        1
    )
VAR __WFA =
    IF (
        NOT ISBLANK ( __Err ),
        IF ( AND ( __WFA1 < __WFATarget, AND ( __WFA2 < __WFATarget, __WFA3 < __WFATarget ) ), 0.34 )
    )
VAR __CurAttain =
    IF (
        NOT ISBLANK ( __Err ),
        IF (
            AND ( __Attain1 > 1.15, AND ( __Attain2 > 1.15, __Attain3 > 1.15 ) ),
            1.16,
            IF (
                AND ( __Attain1 < 0.85, AND ( __Attain2 < 0.85, __Attain3 < 0.85 ) ),
                0.84,
                1
            )
        )
    )
VAR __AllErrPM =
    CALCULATE (
        'View By'[View By Err Level 8 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error],
        ALLSELECTED ( 'Demand Forecasts 2.0' ),
        'View By'[View By] = __vb,
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[SOH_Flag] = "Unversioned",
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month] = __Month_1
    )
VAR __percentile = ( __Err1 + __Err2 + __Err3 ) / __ALLErr
VAR __percentilePM = __Err1 / __ALLErrPM
VAR __Calc =
    IF (
        AND (
            __percentile > __critical,
            AND (
                AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __WFA ), __WFA < __WFATarget ),
                OR ( __CurAttain < 0.85, __CurAttain > 1.15 )
            )
        ),
        "Critical",
        --"Critical"
        IF (
            AND (
                __percentile > __veryImp,
                AND (
                    AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __WFA ), __WFA < __WFATarget ),
                    OR ( __CurAttain < 0.85, __CurAttain > 1.15 )
                )
            ),
            "Very Important",
            --"Very Important"
            IF (
                AND ( __percentile > __critical, AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __WFA ), __WFA < __WFATarget ) ),
                "Important",
                --"Important"
                IF (
                    AND (
                        AND ( __percentilePM > __critical, AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __WFA1 ), __WFA1 < __WFATarget ) ),
                        OR ( __Attain1 < 0.85, __Attain1 > 1.15 )
                    ),
                    "PM Exceptions",
                    --"PM Exceptions"
                    "Ignore" --"Ignore"
                )
            )
        )
    )
RETURN
    IF (
    NOT ISBLANK ( [View By Err Level 8 Dynamic Consensus Abs Error] ),
     __Calc )

calculation:
VAR __WFATarget = 'Forecast Diagnostics'[WFA_Target_100_Percent]

VAR __BiasTrend = 'Forecast Diagnostics'[Bias_Trend1] + 'Forecast Diagnostics'[Bias_Trend2] + 'Forecast Diagnostics'[Bias_Trend3]
VAR __Err =
    IF (
        AND (
            OR (
                NOT OR (
                    ISBLANK ( 'Forecast Diagnostics'[SOH1] ),
                    'Forecast Diagnostics'[SOH1] = 0
                ),
                NOT OR (
                    ISBLANK ( 'Forecast Diagnostics'[Consensus_Demand_1] ),
                    'Forecast Diagnostics'[Consensus_Demand_1] = 0
                )
            ),
            AND (
                OR (
                    NOT OR (
                        ISBLANK ( 'Forecast Diagnostics'[SOH2] ),
                        'Forecast Diagnostics'[SOH2] = 0
                    ),
                    NOT OR (
                        ISBLANK ( 'Forecast Diagnostics'[Consensus_Demand_2] ),
                        'Forecast Diagnostics'[Consensus_Demand_2] = 0
                    )
                ),
                OR (
                    NOT OR (
                        ISBLANK ( 'Forecast Diagnostics'[SOH3] ),
                        'Forecast Diagnostics'[SOH3] = 0
                    ),
                    NOT OR (
                        ISBLANK ( 'Forecast Diagnostics'[Consensus_Demand_3] ),
                        'Forecast Diagnostics'[Consensus_Demand_3] = 0
                    )
                )
            )
        ),
        1
    )
VAR __WFA =
    IF (
        NOT ISBLANK ( __Err ),
        IF (
            AND (
                'Forecast Diagnostics'[WFA1] < __WFATarget,
                AND (
                    'Forecast Diagnostics'[WFA2] < __WFATarget,
                    'Forecast Diagnostics'[WFA3] < __WFATarget
                )
            ),
            0.34
        )
    )
VAR __CurAttain =
    IF (
        NOT ISBLANK ( __Err ),
        IF (
            AND (
                OR (
                    ISBLANK ( 'Forecast Diagnostics'[Attainment_1] ),
                    'Forecast Diagnostics'[Attainment_1] > 1.15
                ),
                AND (
                    OR (
                        ISBLANK ( 'Forecast Diagnostics'[Attainment_2] ),
                        'Forecast Diagnostics'[Attainment_2] > 1.15
                    ),
                    OR (
                        ISBLANK ( 'Forecast Diagnostics'[Attainment_3] ),
                        'Forecast Diagnostics'[Attainment_3] > 1.15
                    )
                )
            ),
            1.16,
            IF (
                AND (
                    OR (
                        ISBLANK ( 'Forecast Diagnostics'[Attainment_1] ),
                        'Forecast Diagnostics'[Attainment_1] < 0.85
                    ),
                    AND (
                        OR (
                            ISBLANK ( 'Forecast Diagnostics'[Attainment_2] ),
                            'Forecast Diagnostics'[Attainment_2] < 0.85
                        ),
                        OR (
                            ISBLANK ( 'Forecast Diagnostics'[Attainment_3] ),
                            'Forecast Diagnostics'[Attainment_3] < 0.85
                        )
                    )
                ),
                0.84,
                1
            )
        )
    )
VAR __percentile = 'Forecast Diagnostics'[Ranked_Percentile_UNT_3M]
VAR __percentilePM = 'Forecast Diagnostics'[Ranked_Percentile_UNT_1M]
VAR __Calc =
    IF (
        AND (
            __percentile < 50,
            AND (
                AND (
                    AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __WFA ), __WFA < __WFATarget ),
                    OR ( __BiasTrend = 3, __BiasTrend = -3 )
                ),
                OR ( __CurAttain < 0.85, __CurAttain > 1.15 )
            )
        ),
        "Critical",
        --"Critical"
        IF (
            AND (
                __percentile < 65,
                AND (
                    AND (
                        AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __WFA ), __WFA < __WFATarget ),
                        OR ( __BiasTrend = 3, __BiasTrend = -3 )
                    ),
                    OR ( __CurAttain < 0.85, __CurAttain > 1.15 )
                )
            ),
            "Very Important",
            --"Very Important"
            IF (
                AND ( __percentile < 50, AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __WFA ), __WFA < __WFATarget ) ),
                "Important",
                --"Important"
                IF (
                    AND (
                        AND (
                            __percentilePM < 50,
                            AND (
                                NOT ISBLANK ( 'Forecast Diagnostics'[WFA1] ),
                                'Forecast Diagnostics'[WFA1] < __WFATarget
                            )
                        ),
                        OR (
                            'Forecast Diagnostics'[Attainment_1] < 0.85,
                            'Forecast Diagnostics'[Attainment_1] > 1.15
                        )
                    ),
                    "PM Exceptions",
                    --"PM Exceptions"
                    "Ignore" --"Ignore"
                )
            )
        )
    )
RETURN
    __Calc

VAR __WFATarget = 'Forecast Diagnostics'[WFA_Target_100_Percent]
VAR __BiasTrend =  'Forecast Diagnostics'[Bias_Trend1_USD] +  'Forecast Diagnostics'[Bias_Trend2_USD] +  'Forecast Diagnostics'[Bias_Trend3_USD]

VAR __Err =
    IF (

VAR __WFA =

        IF (

                AND (
                    'Forecast Diagnostics'[WFA2_USD] < __WFATarget,

VAR __CurAttain =

        IF (
            AND (

                    ISBLANK ( 'Forecast Diagnostics'[Attainment_1_USD] ),
                    'Forecast Diagnostics'[Attainment_1_USD] > 1.15
                ),
                AND (
                    OR (
                        ISBLANK ( 'Forecast Diagnostics'[Attainment_2_USD] ),
                        'Forecast Diagnostics'[Attainment_2_USD] > 1.15
                    ),
                    OR (
                        ISBLANK ( 'Forecast Diagnostics'[Attainment_3_USD] ),
                        'Forecast Diagnostics'[Attainment_3_USD] > 1.15
                    )
                )
            ),
            1.16,
            IF (
                AND (
                    OR (
                        ISBLANK ( 'Forecast Diagnostics'[Attainment_1_USD] ),
                        'Forecast Diagnostics'[Attainment_1_USD] < 0.85
                    ),
                    AND (
                        OR (
                            ISBLANK ( 'Forecast Diagnostics'[Attainment_2_USD] ),
                            'Forecast Diagnostics'[Attainment_2_USD] < 0.85
                        ),
                        OR (
                            ISBLANK ( 'Forecast Diagnostics'[Attainment_3_USD] ),
                            'Forecast Diagnostics'[Attainment_3_USD] < 0.85
                        )
                    )
                ),
                0.84,
                1
            )
        )
    )
VAR __percentile = 'Forecast Diagnostics'[Ranked_Percentile_USD_3M]
VAR __percentilePM = 'Forecast Diagnostics'[Ranked_Percentile_USD_1M]
VAR __Calc =
    IF (
        AND (
            __percentile < 50,
            AND (
              AND( AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __WFA ), __WFA < __WFATarget ), OR ( __BiasTrend = 3,__BiasTrend = -3 )),
                OR ( __CurAttain < 0.85, __CurAttain > 1.15 )
            )
        ),
        "Critical",
        --"Critical"
        IF (
            AND (
                __percentile < 65,
                AND (
              AND( AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __WFA ), __WFA < __WFATarget ), OR (__BiasTrend = 3, __BiasTrend= -3 )),
                    OR ( __CurAttain < 0.85, __CurAttain > 1.15 )
                )
            ),
            "Very Important",
            --"Very Important"
            IF (
                AND ( __percentile < 50, AND ( NOT ISBLANK ( __WFA ), __WFA < __WFATarget ) ),
                "Important",
                --"Important"
                IF (
                    AND (
                        AND (
                            __percentilePM < 50,
                            AND (
                                NOT ISBLANK ( 'Forecast Diagnostics'[WFA1_USD] ),
                                'Forecast Diagnostics'[WFA1_USD] < __WFATarget
                            )
                        ),
                        OR (
                            'Forecast Diagnostics'[Attainment_1_USD] < 0.85,
                            'Forecast Diagnostics'[Attainment_1_USD] > 1.15
                        )
                    ),
                    "PM Exceptions",

                )

    )
RETURN
    __Calc

IF (

        )
    )

ABC Analysis is an approach for classifying items based on their classification value. The value is the total value of an item calculated over a specified time period. This approach is based off the Pareto Principal i.e. the 80/20 rule which states for many events, 80% of the effects come from 20% of the causes. The ABC Indicator denotes which items are classified as: A - Signficant Material, B - Medium Significance Material, C - Low Significance Material, D - Least Significance, E- Zero Significance or O - Obsolete.

field: Mat Plant Demand Next 6 Months PCN
calculation:
VAR CurrentWeekStart =
    CALCULATE (
        MIN ( 'Time'[Reporting Date] ),
        FILTER (
            'Time',
            'Time'[Year] = YEAR ( TODAY () )
                && 'Time'[Fiscal Week] = WEEKNUM ( TODAY (), 2 )
        )
    )
VAR EndDate = CurrentWeekStart + 7 * 21
RETURN
    CALCULATE (
        [Total Demand Wrt Months],
        FILTER (
            'Time',
            'Time'[Reporting Date] >= CurrentWeekStart
                && 'Time'[Reporting Date] <= EndDate
        ),
        USERELATIONSHIP ( 'Bill of Materials Component PCN'[Material Plant Key ID], 'Production and Sales Inventory'[Material Plant Id] )
    )

VAR CurrentMonthT2 =

        MAX ( 'Time'[Month_Date] ),

    )
VAR MonthFilterByName =
    CALCULATE (
        MAX ( 'SCR Layout'[Month Bucket] ),
        'SCR Layout'[Month Name] = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'SCR Layout'[Month Name] )
    )
VAR MonthFilterByBucket =
    SELECTEDVALUE ( 'SCR Layout'[Month Bucket] )
VAR Bucket =
    COALESCE ( MonthFilterByName, MonthFilterByBucket )
VAR MonthFilter =
    CALCULATE (
        MAX ( 'SCR Layout'[Month Filter] ),
        'SCR Layout'[Month Bucket] = Bucket
    )
VAR A =
    SELECTEDVALUE ( 'Time'[Year Month Code], MonthFilter )
VAR CurrentMonthT =

VAR Diff =
    DATEDIFF ( CurrentMonthT, CurrentMonthT2, MONTH ) - 1
VAR diff1 =
    IF ( Diff > 0 || Diff < -6, 0, Diff )
VAR RollingWindow =
    DATESINPERIOD ( 'Time'[Month_Date], CurrentMonthT, diff1, MONTH )
RETURN
    CALCULATE (
        SUMX ( RollingWindow, [Draft Ending Inv] ),
        ALL ( 'Time' ),
        RollingWindow
    )
        + CALCULATE (
            [Past Due Receipts 2.0],
            ALL ( 'Time'[Year Month Code] ),
            ALL ( 'SCR Layout' )
        )

Example: If Last Week is used with an Anchor Week End Date of 6/5/2021 then the Last Week would aggregate sales for 5/30/2021 – 6/5/2021. Anchor Date definition may change depending on the fact selected. Snapshot Facts: Anchor Date is the date the snapshot was taken. Example: Open Orders Snapshot with an Anchor Date selection of 6/7/2021, the data represents what Open Orders were on 6/7/2021. Non-Snapshot Facts: Anchor Date is the last date of transactions included in the time period selected. calculation:
VAR FactInter =
    SUMMARIZE (
        'Intercompany Stock Transfers',
        'Intercompany Stock Transfers'[Calendar_Day],
        'Intercompany Stock Transfers'[Plant_Code],
        'Intercompany Stock Transfers'[Material_Code]
    )
VAR FactDmd =
    SUMMARIZE (
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0',
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Sold_To_Code],
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Cal._year_/_month_char],
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Plant_Code],
        'Demand Forecasts 2.0'[Material_Code]
    )
VAR FactSales =
    SUMMARIZE (
        'Sales Orders',
        'Sales Orders'[Expected_Ship_Date],
        'Sales Orders'[Reason_for_rejection_Code],
        'Sales Orders'[Plant_Code],
        'Sales Orders'[Material_Code]
    )
VAR FactSupply =
    SUMMARIZE (
        'Supply Planning',
        'Supply Planning'[Period_Ending_Date],
        'Supply Planning'[SNP_Week_End_Date],
        'Supply Planning'[Plant_Code],
        'Supply Planning'[Material_Code]
    )
VAR FinalResult =
    COUNTROWS ( FactInter ) + COUNTROWS ( FactDmd )
        + COUNTROWS ( FactSales )
        + COUNTROWS ( FactSupply )
RETURN
    FinalResult
